import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text

def test_split_text_at_zero_with_single_cell_chars():
    """Splitting at column 0 with single-cell characters should return empty left and full right."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"

def test_split_text_at_zero_with_empty_string():
    """Splitting empty string at column 0 should return two empty strings."""
    text = ""
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == ""

def test_split_text_at_zero_with_double_cell_chars():
    """Splitting at column 0 with double-cell characters should return empty left and full right."""
    text = "你好"  # Chinese characters are typically double-cell
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "你好"

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style

def test_split_cells_at_zero_single_cell():
    """split_cells at position 0 should return empty segment and full segment."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "hello"

def test_split_cells_at_zero_empty_text():
    """split_cells at position 0 with empty text should work."""
    segment = Segment("", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == ""

def test_split_cells_at_zero_with_style():
    """split_cells at position 0 should preserve style."""
    style = Style(bold=True)
    segment = Segment("test", style)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.style == style

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text

def test_split_text_mixed_single_and_double_cell():
    """Splitting text with both single and double-cell characters should work."""
    # Mixing ASCII (single-cell) with CJK (double-cell)
    text = "a你b"  # a(1) + 你(2) + b(1) = 4 cells total
    
    # Split at position 1 (after 'a')
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == "a"
    assert right == "你b"
    
    # Split at position 3 (after '你')
    left, right = split_text(text, 3)
    assert left == "a你"
    assert right == "b"

def test_split_text_inside_double_cell_char():
    """Splitting inside a double-cell character replaces it with spaces."""
    text = "你"  # Double-cell character
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    # When cut lands inside a 2-cell char, it becomes two spaces
    assert left == " "
    assert right == " "

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style

def test_split_cells_at_zero_preserves_control():
    """split_cells at position 0 should preserve control codes."""
    control_code = (1,)  # Example control code
    segment = Segment("test", Style(), control=control_code)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.control == control_code
    assert right.control == control_code

def test_split_cells_boundary_single_cell():
    """split_cells at exact character boundaries should work."""
    segment = Segment("abc", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(1)
    assert left.text == "a"
    assert right.text == "bc"
    
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "ab"
    assert right.text == "c"

def test_split_cells_at_zero_no_style():
    """split_cells at position 0 with None style should work."""
    segment = Segment("test", None)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "test"
    assert left.style is None
    assert right.style is None

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text

def test_split_text_zero_with_various_lengths():
    """Splitting at zero should work for various text lengths."""
    test_cases = [
        "a",
        "hello",
        "x" * 100,
        "test string with spaces",
    ]
    
    for text in test_cases:
        left, right = split_text(text, 0)
        assert left == "", f"Failed for text: {text}"
        assert right == text, f"Failed for text: {text}"

def test_split_text_zero_returns_correct_types():
    """Splitting at zero should always return two strings."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert isinstance(left, str)
    assert isinstance(right, str)

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text

def test_split_text_zero_vs_negative():
    """split_text at 0 should work; negative should be handled."""
    text = "hello"
    # At zero should work
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"
    
    # Negative should also return empty left and full right
    left, right = split_text(text, -5)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"

def test_split_text_consistency():
    """Multiple splits should be consistent."""
    text = "hello world"
    
    # Split at 0 twice should give same result
    left1, right1 = split_text(text, 0)
    left2, right2 = split_text(text, 0)
    
    assert left1 == left2
    assert right1 == right2
    assert left1 == ""
    assert right1 == "hello world"
